mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO prescription_item ( prescription_id, drug_id, dosage, frequency, days, quantity, created_by, updated_by, deleted ) VALUES
( #{item.prescriptionId}, #{item.drugId}, #{item.dosage}, #{item.frequency}, #{item.days}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.createdBy}, #{item.updatedBy}, #{item.deleted} )
mapper.select: SELECT pi.id, pi.drug_id, d.drug_code, d.drug_name, pi.dosage, pi.frequency, pi.days, pi.quantity FROM prescription_item pi INNER JOIN drug d ON d.id = pi.drug_id WHERE pi.prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} AND pi.deleted = 0 AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY pi.id ASC
